claims.statement: The selected document presents a relation-first model of time, virtual retrocausality, node-local event time, proof rings and a monotonically growing evidence sphere.
Within the defined formal model, future-indexed addressing and reverse reconstruction of fully logged traces are constructively expressible without rewriting sealed predecessor bytes.
A closed proof or audit ring is not thereby a closed physical timelike curve.
The evidence sphere grows append-only by adding newly bound evidence; earlier sealed evidence is not silently rewritten.
The document attributes the relation-first ontology, TEMDD, Round Trip, node-local event time, proof ring, growing sphere and virtual retrocausality conception to Ingolf Lohmann.
The selected document does not by itself report independently replicated positive capacity for a controllable physical future-to-past messaging channel.

Zenodo publication of the byte-exact artifact would establish a public citable record and byte identity, not peer review, empirical confirmation, scientific consensus, PASS, FINAL_PASS or general EFFECT_ACK_DONE.
